name: patina
title_zh: 韩英中日四语去AI味，改完保原意可验证
tagline_zh: 一眼认出ChatGPT写的韩英中日文，重写成像人话。不像别的改写工具改完就跑，它用MPS机制逐句核对原意没丢。
tagline_en: Spot and rewrite ChatGPT-sounding Korean, English, Chinese, Japanese into human prose. Unlike other rewriters, it.
desc_en: Detect and rewrite AI writing patterns in Korean, English, Chinese, and Japanese text so it reads as if a human wrote it. Meaning-preservation (MPS) verified.
why_zh: 自带意义保持验证（MPS），不是凭感觉改完就交差。逐句比对改写前后语义，丢了一层意思它会拦下来告诉你。
why_en: Built-in meaning-preservation verification (MPS). It doesn't just rewrite and run—it compares before/after semantics and stops.
limit_zh: 只处理韩英中日四语文本，不识别图片/PDF里的字；改写质量依赖原文可读性，原文本身逻辑混乱时它只能修表面。
limit_en: Text-only, 4 languages (KO/EN/ZH/JA). No OCR. Rewrite quality caps at source clarity; MPS may miss subtle puns or cultural allusions.
